courses.title: Prescribed Electives or UG Cert Courses
courses.choice_note: Select 41 hours of track specific requirements OR Undergraduate Certificate for Health and Social Care Professionals (18 SCH) + HLTH 3392 and 23 SCH of Prescribed Electives courses, not to exceed 20 combined credit hours of science and math. Must complete 42 credit hours of advanced credit (3000-4000). Please note that HLTH 3355 double dips in both the Major: Foundation and Undergraduate Certificate areas. Pre-nursing and pre-chiropractic students should take BIOL 2420 or BIOL 3470 Fall of second year. Pre-nursing students must take FSCN 2362 .
